name: Teen Job and Volunteer Fair (Santa Barbara Public Library)
what_you_do: Meet local employers and nonprofits face to face. Look for summer jobs, internships and volunteer roles. A teen interview skills workshop is held the following week.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 9 to 12. Parents and guardians are welcome. No registration needed for the fair; the interview workshop needs registration.
deadline_text: 2026 fair: Wednesday, April 15, 2026, 4:00 to 6:00 PM at Central Library (workshop April 22). The 2027 date is not posted; the library calls it annual.
how_to_apply: Just show up. Sign up separately for the Teen Interview Skills Workshop.
notes: 2026 employers included the Museum of Natural History and Sea Center, MOXI, Santa Barbara Museum of Art, Santa Barbara Zoo, City Parks and Recreation, and the Postal Service. More than 200 teens attended in 2025.
